scripts.test: node tests/test-parsers.mjs && node tests/test-chunked-write.mjs && node tests/test-open-in-terminal.mjs && node tests/test-project-picker.mjs && node tests/test-project-listener.mjs

0.10.0: Fixed: loadProjectLabels fired one `git rev-parse` per unique project path via an unbounded Promise.all, so users with more than 32 distinct project directories hit Muxy's `exec: too many concurrent commands (limit 32)` error and got an empty gitToplevelMap. Now batched in groups of 16.

Fixed: mount-time sync and the polling fallback relied only on `muxy.git.repoInfo()`, which returns `{}` whenever the focused Muxy tab isn't itself a git-scoped terminal (e.g. an agent/Claude Code tab, or the extension panel itself) — even though Muxy's project switcher has an active project. Added `getActiveProjectPath(muxy)`, which falls back to the `isActive` project from `muxy.projects.list()`.

Fixed: `setupProjectChangeListener()` ran synchronously at script load, before Muxy's `muxy` global was guaranteed to exist, so `startPollingFallback` could silently never install its interval. It's now deferred until after the first `loadConversations()` resolves.

Fixed: polling only started when zero of the 6 guessed project-change event names subscribed successfully, but `muxy.events.subscribe` doesn't validate event names — a bogus 'subscribed' result permanently blocked the reliable polling path. Polling now always runs alongside any event subscription.
Changed: auto-follow polling interval lowered from 3000ms to 250ms so project switches in Muxy are picked up faster.

Fixed: worktree auto-follow never worked because the manifest was missing the worktrees:read permission — muxy.worktrees.list() threw 'permission denied', silently caught, always falling back to the parent project's path. Added worktrees:read to muxy.permissions.

Fixed: a newly-active path with no conversation history yet (e.g. a fresh worktree) showed as a raw stale-filter path instead of the 'project · branch' label, since loadProjectLabels only resolves paths already seen in conversation history. Added ensureToplevelKnown(path), called from mount-time sync and applyFilter, to resolve it on demand.

Fixed: muxy.worktrees.list({project: id}) threw 'project not found [object Object]' on this Muxy build — the id must be passed positionally, list(id), not wrapped in an options object. getActiveProjectPath now tries the positional form first, falling back to the options-object and no-arg forms for other Muxy versions.

Fixed: a fresh worktree's 'project · branch' label still didn't render even after ensureToplevelKnown resolved it, because getPickerLabel's stale-filter fallback only checked conversation-derived groups and went straight to the raw path. It now also checks extractRepoLabel directly against gitToplevelMap/worktreeInfoMap first.

Auto-follow tracks git worktrees: when the active Muxy project is a linked worktree, getActiveProjectPath resolves to the worktree's own path (via muxy.worktrees.list()/muxy.git.worktrees() + isWorktreeActive) instead of the parent project's path.

Worktrees get their own WORKTREES section in the picker (between PROJECTS and PATHS) labeled 'project · branch', instead of being mixed into PROJECTS under their raw directory name. projectDisplayGroups now returns a third `worktrees` array split out of `git`; loadProjectLabels detects linked worktrees via git rev-parse --git-common-dir + git branch --show-current (batched).

Auto-sync Muxy project on panel mount: when the panel loads, the filter reflects Muxy's currently active project (`muxy.git.repoInfo().root`) even if no project-change event has fired yet. Runs ONCE per panel mount — gated by `state.initialSyncDone` — so clicking Refresh does not re-fire the sync and override a filter the user picked in the picker.

Picker button shows the abbreviated path when the filter is stale (e.g. the active Muxy project has no conversation history): the filter value is run through `displayPathLabel` so a long path like `/Users/x/Repos/muxy-extensions/scratch/cool` renders as `…/scratch/cool` rather than the misleading literal `All projects`. Null/empty groups still show `All projects` since there is no path to abbreviate.

PATHS section in the picker abbreviates long paths to `…/last2` (with `~` for `$HOME`): path items now go through `displayPathLabel(label, home)` so a path like `/Users/x/scratch` becomes `~/scratch` and `/Users/x/Repos/muxy-extensions/scratch/cool` becomes `…/scratch/cool`.
0.9.1: Auto-follow (v0.9.0) was effectively undebuggable: the listener emitted diagnostic info via console.log, but Muxy's debugger does not surface console.log from the panel iframe, so the user could not tell whether the listener was running, whether the 6 candidate event names worked, or whether polling was needed.

The listener now reports its state via the panel's status bar (visible without DevTools): 'Auto-follow: listening to <event>' on install, 'Auto-follow: muxy.events unavailable' when muxy.events.subscribe is missing, 'Auto-follow: no Muxy event worked, polling as fallback' when all candidates throw, and 'Filter synced: <basename>' every time the filter is applied.

Added a polling fallback that activates automatically when none of the 6 candidate event names are recognized by the user's Muxy version. The polling watches muxy.git.repoInfo().root on a 3-second interval. The helper lives in src/panel/project-change-listener.js as startPollingFallback so it is unit-testable. The algorithm is symmetric with the event helper and updates its lastActiveRoot on every observed tick (before the dedup check against state.projectFilter) to prevent thrash loops.

Added 20 unit tests (17 cases) for the polling helper in tests/test-project-listener.mjs, covering the baseline capture, dedup against state.projectFilter, defensive typeof check, repoInfo throws, malformed payloads, onFilterChange throws, and custom intervalMs.
0.9.0: Auto-switch direction inverted: the panel now follows Muxy's active project (Muxy → extension) instead of pushing project changes to Muxy (extension → Muxy). When you change the active project in Muxy, the panel filter updates automatically and the picker button reflects the new project.

The v0.8.0/v0.8.1 auto-switch (which called muxy.projects.switchTo from picker clicks and breadcrumb clicks) has been removed. Picker and breadcrumb clicks now only filter the local view — they do not change Muxy's active project.

New file src/panel/project-change-listener.js: pure helpers (extractPathFromProjectEvent, setupProjectChangeListener, PROJECT_CHANGE_CANDIDATES) that subscribe to a candidate list of Muxy project-change events and apply the new path to the panel. Extracted for unit testability.

When the user is reading a conversation in detail view and Muxy switches projects, the detail view is preserved — only state.projectFilter and the list are updated. The detail view reflects the new filter when the user navigates back.

The 'openInTerminal' flow (v0.5) still auto-switches Muxy to the project that owns the conversation before opening the terminal, so the terminal's cwd matches the conversation. This is a different use case (preparing context for an action) and is intentionally preserved.
0.8.1: Auto-switch (v0.8.0) was too silent: failures (no match, list/switchTo errors) and the already-active case had no UI feedback. Now every outcome emits a status bar message (warn/err/ok) and every step logs a [ai-history] diagnostic line to the console for easy debugging in Muxy DevTools.
0.8.0: Auto-switch to the selected project: choosing a project in the picker (or clicking a breadcrumb in the detail view) switches Muxy to that project when a matching one exists. The next resume in terminal then skips the project switch step. The switch is silent (status bar only).
0.7.0: Project picker menu with search, replacing the static <select> dropdown
Click on a conversation now resumes the session in a terminal; Cmd/Ctrl+Click opens the detail view
Breadcrumb navigation in the detail view (clickable to filter by subpath)
Path abbreviation with ~ for $HOME in conversation list
Copy path action in the 3-dot menu
Cmd+P / Ctrl+P global shortcut to open the project picker
Project detection fix: cache invalidation on refresh, ~ and $HOME expansion in OpenCode sessions
Removed 'Open in Terminal' from the 3-dot menu (now the primary click action)

muxy.description: View conversation history from Claude Code and OpenCode inside Muxy.
